Fifty more events continuing "Isola — Armor, Weapons, and Inherited Traditions" (events 01-45, shipped as ARMOR-01..45). Same style as yours: "NN. Title — one or two sentences", numbered 46-95.

collection.description: A family lines an old curved shield with soft mats so a baby can nap in it on the floor of the hut.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: A family lines an old curved shield with soft mats so a baby can nap in it on the floor of the hut. Some relatives find it sweet; others wonder what the shield's makers would have thought.
